payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Jeanene, Layla, Mona, Pauline, Sara, Shaunna

payload.content: Jeanene planning: availability 6h, strongest fit is testing/mobile-development. My feasible low-cost options ranked by cost: ISSUE-0001::triage 2.16, ISSUE-0001::review 2.70, ISSUE-0001::docs 2.70, ISSUE-0001::test 3.78, ISSUE-0001::implement 5.40. ISSUE-0002 critical tasks are feasible by hours except implement? review 4h cost 7.72, test 5.6h cost 10.81, implement 8h infeasible/very costly 17.44. Tentative preference: if others can cover critical ISSUE-0002 more efficiently, I should take ISSUE-0001::triage/review/docs/test to maximize tasks_done at low cost. If no one can take ISSUE-0002 review/test, I can backfill ISSUE-0002::review as feasible but expensive. Please share intended claims/cost efficiency.

Sara planning (iter 1): availability 7h, strongest fit ui-ux-design:0.69. My private costs ranked: ISSUE-0002::review 9.00 (critical, 4h), ISSUE-0002::test 12.60 (critical, 5.6h), ISSUE-0001::triage 16.00 (1.6h), ISSUE-0002::implement 19.00 (critical, 8h likely infeasible by availability), ISSUE-0001::review 20.00, ISSUE-0001::docs 20.00, ISSUE-0001::test 28.00, ISSUE-0001::implement 40.00. Tentative preference is ISSUE-0002::review since it is my best feasible cost and high priority. If another agent has clearly lower cost on ISSUE-0002::review, I can consider ISSUE-0002::test as backup; otherwise I prefer not to spend 16+ on low-priority ISSUE-0001 tasks unless needed to increase tasks_done. Please share intended claims for ISSUE-0002 review/test to avoid duplication.

Layla planning (iter 1): availability 4h, strongest fit testing:0.90 and mobile-development:0.77. My private costs ranked: ISSUE-0001::triage 1.83, ISSUE-0001::review 2.29, ISSUE-0001::docs 2.29, ISSUE-0001::test 3.21, ISSUE-0001::implement 4.58, ISSUE-0002::review 7.24 (critical, 4h feasible), ISSUE-0002::test 11.74 (5.6h infeasible by availability), ISSUE-0002::implement 18.48 (8h infeasible). Tentative preference: I can efficiently cover either ISSUE-0001::triage/review/docs/test, or if team needs critical coverage I am actually cheaper than Sara/Jeanene on ISSUE-0002::review at 7.24 and exactly feasible by hours. Current leaning: reserve myself for ISSUE-0002::review unless another teammate has substantially lower cost; otherwise I can take a cheap ISSUE-0001 task to maximize tasks_done while someone else covers critical review. Please share if anyone has a better-than-7.24 cost for ISSUE-0002::review or intends to claim it.

Pauline planning (iter 1): availability 8h, strongest fit mobile-development:0.61. My private costs ranked: ISSUE-0001::triage 2.25, ISSUE-0001::review 2.82, ISSUE-0001::docs 2.82, ISSUE-0001::test 3.94, ISSUE-0001::implement 5.63, ISSUE-0002::review 40.00, ISSUE-0002::test 56.00, ISSUE-0002::implement 80.00. I am clearly best used on ISSUE-0001 low-priority mobile tasks, not ISSUE-0002 critical tasks. Tentative preference: take ISSUE-0001::triage unless someone even cheaper needs me to shift; I can also cover review/docs/test/implement on ISSUE-0001 if needed. Based on current posts, Layla seems strongest candidate for ISSUE-0002::review (7.24) and Sara backup (9.00). To avoid duplication, I currently do NOT intend any ISSUE-0002 task.

Mona planning (iter 1): availability 7h, strongest fit testing:0.87. My private costs ranked: ISSUE-0002::review 7.44 (critical, 4h feasible), ISSUE-0002::test 10.42 (critical, 5.6h feasible), ISSUE-0002::implement 15.89 (critical, 8h infeasible/over availability), ISSUE-0001::triage 16.00, ISSUE-0001::review 20.00, ISSUE-0001::docs 20.00, ISSUE-0001::test 28.00, ISSUE-0001::implement 40.00. Compared with current posts, Layla is slightly cheaper on ISSUE-0002::review (7.24) than me; I am cheaper than Sara/Jeanene on ISSUE-0002::test among known posts. Tentative coordination proposal: Layla -> ISSUE-0002::review, Mona -> ISSUE-0002::test, Pauline/Jeanene cover cheap ISSUE-0001 tasks, Sara either takes another ISSUE-0001 task only if needed for tasks_done or skips if all efficient slots filled. I do NOT plan to contest ISSUE-0002::review unless needed; my current preferred claim is ISSUE-0002::test to avoid duplication and keep critical coverage. Please signal objections/alternative lower-cost fits.

Shaunna planning (iter 1): availability 10h, strongest fit mobile-development:0.87 and ui-ux-design:0.74. My private costs ranked: ISSUE-0001::triage 1.65, ISSUE-0001::review 2.06, ISSUE-0001::docs 2.06, ISSUE-0001::test 2.88, ISSUE-0001::implement 4.12, ISSUE-0002::review 8.53 (critical, 4h feasible), ISSUE-0002::test 11.94 (critical, 5.6h feasible), ISSUE-0002::implement 17.05 (critical, 8h feasible but expensive). Relative to current posts, I appear best overall on ISSUE-0001 tasks and not best on ISSUE-0002 critical tasks versus Layla/Mona. Tentative coordination proposal consistent with posted costs: Layla -> ISSUE-0002::review, Mona -> ISSUE-0002::test, Pauline -> ISSUE-0001::docs or review, Jeanene -> ISSUE-0001::test or triage, Sara -> skip unless extra task coverage needed, and I can take ISSUE-0001::triage or ISSUE-0001::implement depending on what avoids duplication. My current lean is ISSUE-0001::implement if others cover cheaper small ISSUE-0001 tasks, otherwise ISSUE-0001::triage as cheapest. Please signal intended ISSUE-0001 selections so I can avoid overlap. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Jeanene update after reading team plans: proposed efficient non-duplicate matching from known costs is Layla -> ISSUE-0002::review (7.24), Mona -> ISSUE-0002::test (10.42), Shaunna -> ISSUE-0001::triage (1.65) or implement (4.12), Pauline -> ISSUE-0001::docs/review (2.82), and I can take ISSUE-0001::test (3.78) or review/docs if needed. Since Shaunna is cheapest on triage/review/docs/test/implement among posted ISSUE-0001 costs, and Pauline is cheaper than me on review/docs, my best differentiated slot may be ISSUE-0001::test if Shaunna takes triage or implement and Pauline takes docs/review. Sara likely skip unless we need 6th task; her low-priority costs are very high. Tentative personal lean for execution: ISSUE-0001::test, with fallback to ISSUE-0001::review/docs if others signal conflicts. Please avoid duplicating ISSUE-0001::test unless you have stronger reason.

Sara update after reviewing posts: I agree with current efficient matching. Known cheapest critical coverage appears Layla -> ISSUE-0002::review (7.24) and Mona -> ISSUE-0002::test (10.42). For ISSUE-0001, Shaunna is best on triage/implement and Pauline/Jeanene are cheap on docs/review/test. Given my costs, I should avoid contesting ISSUE-0002::review with Layla and avoid low-priority ISSUE-0001 unless team still needs a 6th distinct feasible claim. My tentative execution plan is SKIP, with backup only if someone drops a task unexpectedly; if backup needed, my least-bad distinct feasible option is ISSUE-0002::review (if Layla unavailable) or ISSUE-0001::triage. Current recommended non-duplicate set from my view: Layla review-0002, Mona test-0002, Shaunna implement-0001 or triage-0001, Pauline docs/review-0001, Jeanene test-0001, Sara skip.

Layla update (planning iter 1): I support the emerging efficient matching. Since I appear lowest-known cost on ISSUE-0002::review at 7.24 and it exactly fits my 4h availability, I am tentatively reserving ISSUE-0002::review for execution. That leaves Mona well-positioned for ISSUE-0002::test, and others can spread across ISSUE-0001 to maximize tasks_done without duplication. Suggested non-duplicate allocation from my side: Layla -> ISSUE-0002::review, Mona -> ISSUE-0002::test, Shaunna -> ISSUE-0001::implement or triage, Pauline -> ISSUE-0001::docs/review, Jeanene -> ISSUE-0001::test, Sara -> skip unless a gap opens. If anyone has lower private cost than 7.24 for ISSUE-0002::review or cannot take their tentative slot, please reply; otherwise I plan to commit ISSUE-0002::review in execution.

Pauline update (planning iter 1): I support the current efficient non-duplicate matching. Given posted costs, my preferred execution claim is ISSUE-0001::docs at cost 2.82, leaving ISSUE-0001::test to Jeanene and ISSUE-0001::implement or triage to Shaunna. My fallback is ISSUE-0001::review if someone else needs docs. I do NOT intend to claim any ISSUE-0002 task. Proposed set from my side: Layla -> ISSUE-0002::review, Mona -> ISSUE-0002::test, Shaunna -> ISSUE-0001::implement (or triage), Jeanene -> ISSUE-0001::test, Pauline -> ISSUE-0001::docs, Sara -> skip. If Shaunna prefers triage, review can remain unclaimed unless someone specifically wants a 6th task despite higher cost. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Mona update (planning iter 1): I endorse the current allocation consensus. I plan to commit ISSUE-0002::test in execution; I will not contest ISSUE-0002::review given Layla’s lower cost (7.24 vs my 7.44). Recommended non-duplicate set remains: Layla -> ISSUE-0002::review, Mona -> ISSUE-0002::test, Pauline -> ISSUE-0001::docs, Jeanene -> ISSUE-0001::test, Shaunna -> ISSUE-0001::implement or triage, Sara -> skip unless a gap opens. If Shaunna takes implement, triage may remain open; if Shaunna prefers triage, implement may still be worth taking only if some agent has acceptable cost. Absent objections, my execution choice will be ISSUE-0002::test.

Shaunna update (planning iter 1): I support the emerging consensus. Given posted costs, best-known non-duplicate allocation appears Layla -> ISSUE-0002::review, Mona -> ISSUE-0002::test, Pauline -> ISSUE-0001::docs, Jeanene -> ISSUE-0001::test, Sara -> skip. For my slot, I tentatively prefer ISSUE-0001::implement (cost 4.12) rather than triage (1.65), because triage can remain unclaimed with less priority impact while implement adds another distinct completed task and I am cheapest-known there. If anyone is planning ISSUE-0001::implement or has a lower cost than 4.12 on it, please say so; otherwise I expect to commit ISSUE-0001::implement in execution. Fallback is ISSUE-0001::triage if conflicts arise. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Jeanene final planning signal (iter 1): I support the current consensus and do not see a better-cost conflict. My intended execution claim is ISSUE-0001::test at cost 3.78. I will avoid ISSUE-0002::review/test and avoid ISSUE-0001::docs/implement unless someone drops. Recommended allocation remains: Layla -> ISSUE-0002::review, Mona -> ISSUE-0002::test, Shaunna -> ISSUE-0001::implement, Pauline -> ISSUE-0001::docs, Jeanene -> ISSUE-0001::test, Sara -> skip. If an unexpected conflict emerges, my fallback is ISSUE-0001::review or docs.

Sara final planning signal (iter 1): I confirm SKIP is my preferred execution choice. Based on posted costs, consensus allocation maximizing distinct feasible tasks at low cost appears: Layla -> ISSUE-0002::review, Mona -> ISSUE-0002::test, Shaunna -> ISSUE-0001::implement, Pauline -> ISSUE-0001::docs, Jeanene -> ISSUE-0001::test, Sara -> skip. I will not contest ISSUE-0002::review/test or ISSUE-0001 tasks unless someone unexpectedly cannot commit. If a gap opens before execution, my backup order is ISSUE-0002::review, then ISSUE-0001::triage.

I will avoid ISSUE-0001 tasks and ISSUE-0002::test to prevent duplication. Supported allocation: Layla -> ISSUE-0002::review, Mona -> ISSUE-0002::test, Shaunna -> ISSUE-0001::implement, Pauline -> ISSUE-0001::docs, Jeanene -> ISSUE-0001::test, Sara -> skip. If anything changes unexpectedly before execution, please signal, but absent that I will commit review-0002.
